newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROYLE SAD TO SEE KANCHELSKIS LEAVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROYLE SAD TO SEE KANCHELSKIS LEAVE.

text.p: Everton manager Joe Royle said on Thursday he was sorry to see Russian international Andrei Kanchelskis leave the club "but the time was right".
Kanchelskis is joining Italian serie A club Fiorentina in an eight million pounds ($12.9 million) deal.
Royle said: "He had a terrific season for us last year, but Andrei would admit he has not been at his best this season.
"He's a goalscorer, but because of illness and injury he hasn't been the same Andrei."
Kanchelskis, 28, moved to Everton from fellow premier league club Manchester United in 1995 in a five million pound ($8.1 million) deal.
